source.description:
Core-side xt --role launcher redesign (parent: core bead xtrm-osipt) turns turn-1 into a positional string that must start with '/skill:name' (pi) or '/skill-name' (claude) at literal byte 0 so the runtime slash-command parser force-loads the skill body. Any wrapper, prefix, or leading whitespace breaks slash-cmd parsing silently — the model sees a normal user message that happens to contain '/skill:foo' somewhere in it, no body loads.

## Scope — audit only, no code changes in this bead

1. message-send composition — when message-send delivers text to a target, does it prepend any envelope ('<message from …>', '<from …>', '[from …]:', header, sender attribution, timestamps, JSON wrapper, etc.)? If yes, the recipient pane never sees '/' at position 0 for slash-cmd purposes; any orchestrator flow that tries to force-load a skill via message-send silently fails.

2. safe-send-pointer / handoff / send-keys — same question. These paths are already used to deliver ad-hoc instructions to running panes; if they wrap, quote-escape in a way that shifts the first byte, or otherwise inject leading content, they can't be used to force-load a skill on an already-running pane.

3. Any other delivery primitive in this repo (pane events, hook-triggered messages, picker actions that inject keys, notification-style deliveries) — audit the same rule.

## Outcome branches

- If NO wrapping today on any path: document the invariant explicitly (README + inline comments at each send site) so future changes don't silently break it. No code needed.
- If ANY wrapping today: add a --raw / --no-wrap flag to the affected primitive so the launcher (and any orchestrator that needs slash-cmd semantics) can opt out. File a fix bead separately (this bead is audit-only).

## Why P1

Prereq for the core launcher redesign contract. Without confirmed non-wrapping delivery, the redesign only works for launcher-owned spawn (initial argv the runtime auto-submits). Any downstream orchestrator flow that would re-inject a skill on an already-running pane relies on this being clean.

## References

- Core: xtrm-osipt (closed, stopgap fix landed) + successor launcher-redesign bead (to be filed on core).
- Specialists: unitAI-0o3pv (P1) tracks equivalent pool-isolation gap on their spawn paths.
- Once this audit resolves: xtrm-tools/skills/default/multiplexing/SKILL.md gets a paragraph documenting the position-0 '/' invariant with a link to whichever xtmux primitives are safe (or how to opt out of wrapping).
source.title: audit message-send / send-keys / safe-send-pointer for position-0 wrapping (core launcher-redesign prereq)
